Rishi / Marissa / Olivia — quick technical note from my side:

We ran a 32-GPU perf estimate against the same model family Cloudlytics uses. Key takeaways:
- Expected sustained throughput: ~2.1M tokens/hr per GPU at your median sequence length (32 tokens) with our continuous batching defaults.
- p95 token latency: ~85ms under steady-state; spikes up to ~220ms at 95th when queues build under sustained bursts.
- Memory headroom: 8–10% for KV cache across a 32-GPU reserved pool if we keep your current model (we'll recommend a 4-bit quantized variant for cost efficiency).

Attachment: 32GPU_performance_estimate.csv (contains per-GPU throughput curves and latency percentiles).

For throughput guarantees we can commit to: 99.5% uptime of pool availability and a contractual target for 95th-percentile latency under a defined request profile (we'll add a guardrail that Burst CPU/GPU hours beyond reserved capacity are billed at a separate on-demand rate and subject to availability).
